Haryana Reshuffles Administration, Transfers 3 Senior IAS Officers

The Haryana administration has seen a significant reshuffling with three senior Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers being transferred. Nikhil Garhraj has been appointed to head the transport department, taking charge as the Director General of State Transport. The transfers involve new responsibilities being assigned to these officers within the state's administrative framework.
